title: Plugin Redesign
meta: A cleaner, modern interface for your WooCommerce plugin settings and screens, keeping your users and data. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce plugin redesign, easier for store owners
overview: Store owners judge a plugin by its settings page. We review your admin screens and redesign them so options are grouped, labels are plain and previews show what each setting does. We build the new interface to match the WordPress and WooCommerce admin, using React components where they help, and keep your saved settings and data untouched. We also check it on mobile admin and common color schemes.

pkgs.blurb: A tidier look for up to three admin screens.
Redesigned main screens with tabs, search and inline help.
A complete refresh with a setup wizard and a dashboard widget.

faq: Will my customers' saved settings be kept?
Yes. We change how options are shown, not how they are stored. Existing settings load into the new screens exactly as saved, and we test the update on a copy with real data.
Do you change the store front end too?
Only if your plugin has public output, and only if you ask. This service focuses on the admin screens. We can quote storefront work next to it if your plugin has widgets or blocks.
Do you use React for the new screens?
Where it helps, yes. WordPress ships React components, so we use them for dynamic screens and plain PHP templates for simple ones. We avoid heavy extra libraries to keep the plugin light.
Can you match my own branding?
Yes. We keep the interface native to WordPress and add your logo, accent color and wording. A fully custom look is possible but can make the screens feel foreign to store owners.
